resolution: Root-caused the sphere-owns-cylinder ownership bleed: part ranges are authored-group-id SPANS that keep their [lo,hi) through face deletions, but appendGroupInner minted the new part's ids at maxGroupId(living faces)+1. After the icosphere edits the max living id (55) sat far below the sphere's declared hi (98), so the added cylinder was minted at [56,72) — inside the sphere's span — leaving 52 multiply-owned faces (rangesValid false in the journal dump). Added nextFreeGroupId() in framework/gpu/3d.zig, which also clears every declared part hi, and applied it at the four sites that append a range pair without renormalizing: add part (also covers duplicate/mirror), detach, merge parts, path array. Renormalizing sites were already safe. Needs a host rebuild; existing corrupted doc can be repaired by undoing past 'add part' and re-adding the cylinder.
